description: 150 expert-authored financial QA questions over real SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, earnings releases). Questions range from simple lookups to multi-hop reasoning across document sections.

reasontree_tree_search.notes: Tree search with full reasoning trail. Incorrect answers cluster on tables and exhibits not parsed correctly by PyPDF2.

baseline_flat_vector_rag.notes: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, chunk size 512, top-k=5. Standard production baseline.

baseline_bm25.notes: BM25 retrieval over the same 512-token chunks.

methodology: Questions were answered by passing the retrieval result to the same answer-generation LLM across all systems. Answer correctness was evaluated using exact match for numeric questions and LLM-as-judge for open-ended questions, with a separate judge model (gpt-4o) not used anywhere in the retrieval pipeline.
limitations: Evaluation used the open-source PDF extraction pipeline (PyMuPDF + PyPDF2), not an enhanced OCR pipeline. Complex tables and multi-column layouts occasionally produce malformed text that degrades retrieval.
LLM-as-judge for open-ended questions introduces variance. Results should be treated as approximate.
Runtime cost: tree-search retrieval costs approximately 3-8x more in LLM tokens than a vector lookup for the same query.
